# Vocolens

> AI voice journal for ADHD, autism, and alexithymia. Speak your emotions, track mood patterns, and gain emotional clarity.

## About

Vocolens is an AI-powered voice journaling app designed specifically for neurodivergent minds. Instead of writing, users simply speak - Vocolens transcribes what they say and analyses the words and language to name emotions the conscious mind may overlook, so users finally have language for feelings they couldn't put into words. Built for people with ADHD, autism, alexithymia, and anyone who struggles with traditional journaling or emotional self-awareness.

- Website: https://vocolens.com
- Platform: Android
- Price: Paid subscription with a 3-day free trial (monthly, quarterly, and annual plans)
- Category: Health & Mental Wellness

## Core Value Proposition

- Speak instead of write, so thoughts get out before they slip away or feel too hard to start
- Put a name to feelings you couldn't name yourself, from the words and language in what you said
- See your patterns over time instead of guessing why the same moods keep returning
- Understand yourself without handing your private thoughts to a data-hungry app - see Privacy below
- Reliable speech-to-text (Deepgram Nova-2) so your words are captured without you having to type

## Features

### Journal Calendar
Easily track your progress. Visual mood calendar showing daily entries and emotional patterns over time.

### Weekly Reflection
View your weekly mood story. AI-generated narrative summary of your emotional week, highlighting patterns and shifts.

### Mood Story
See which emotion dominates your days. Daily dominant emotion tracking visualized across the week.

### Explore Deeper
Go as deep as you want. Flexible depth of analysis - from quick check-ins to deep emotional exploration.

### Emotional Landscape
Mapping your mood in one chart. Plutchik's wheel-based emotion mapping showing the full spectrum of your feelings.

### Body Sensation Map
Track your physical feelings. Somatic awareness tool mapping where emotions manifest physically in your body.

### Deep Insights
Clear insights without any noise. Personalized AI insights that learn your emotional dialect - not generic textbook responses.

### Emotional Triggers
Learn what keeps setting you off. Pattern recognition identifying recurring emotional triggers and their contexts.

### Emotional Themes
Your emotional narrative. Recurring emotional patterns and stories surfaced from your journal entries over time.

### Time of Day
Track your mood by the hour. Temporal mood analysis showing how emotions shift throughout your day.

## Who It's For

- People with ADHD who think faster than they can write
- Autistic individuals seeking better emotional self-understanding
- People with alexithymia who struggle to identify and name emotions
- Anyone who finds traditional journaling frustrating or inaccessible
- Neurodivergent individuals wanting to understand their emotional patterns

## Science & Approach

Vocolens is grounded in emotion science including Plutchik's wheel of emotions, affect-labeling research, and somatic (body-sensation) awareness. Emotions are detected by analysing the words and language in your journal transcript. The result: granular emotion mapping beyond simple "happy/sad" categories, so users steadily build emotional vocabulary and self-awareness over time.

## Privacy

Journal entries, audio, and personalization data are stored on your device and locked behind biometric authentication and a PIN. To turn speech into insight, two things leave the device transiently over an encrypted connection: your audio is sent for speech-to-text transcription (Deepgram) and the resulting text transcript is sent for emotion analysis (OpenAI via OpenRouter). Neither service permanently stores your data, and no audio is sent for the emotion analysis step. Full detail: https://vocolens.com/privacy
